area.description: Primary domain: ethics, security, architecture, simulation, api, documentation, operations, etc.

depends_on.description: Queue IDs this item is blocked by.

blocks.description: Queue IDs this item gates. Inverse of depends_on — both sides must be maintained.

decision_owner.description: Who must make the decision: operator, aurora, security-lead, etc.

consumer_fit.description: Who may work this item. Agents must not start human-only items.

context_pack.description: Canonical files the worker MUST read before starting. Not optional.

next_action.description: One-line description of the immediate next step.

aurora_notes.description: Aurora-authored contextual guidance, re-rank rationale, or session carryover note. Written by Aurora, read by all consumers.

is_stale_scope.description: Set true when the reason for urgency is a docs/scope mismatch or stale design state. Triggers +20 score delta in triage_rules.

parallel_group.description: Optional group name for independently actionable items that may be worked simultaneously. Items in the same group do not block each other.

active_worker.description: GitHub username or agent ID currently working this item.

pr.description: Pull request number if state is waiting_review.

opened.description: Date item was added to the queue. Required for escalation timer evaluation.

last_updated.description: Date of most recent state change or aurora_notes update. Required for escalation timer evaluation.

url.description: GitHub issue or PR URL if applicable.
